pages.title: About — ICON CAPITAL
pages.main_text_excerpt:
A Successful Mid-Market Investor
Icon Capital is a team of proactive and commercially focused investment professionals. We take on an active ownership role as partners to management teams and existing owners. Our core niche is the Nordic mid-market segment. Over more than two decades, Icon Capital has helped founders and entrepreneurs materialize their strategic visions to create lasting value. In turn, Icon Capital achieves consistent returns to its own investors.
Currently invested in three Nordic 
mid-sized companies
Managing around NOK 2 billion in committed capital
Consistent success in helping companies grow and scale
Around 500 employees in the current companies
An accomplished and rigorous approach to mid-market value creation underlies Icon Capital’s highly successful track record across all funds

Icon Capital is composed of a highly capable team of professionals. The core team is stable, with a broad range of experience and deep knowledge. The Icon Capital team is proven and highly successful.
